title: Hotel & Airport Check-in (Audio)
description: Listen to realistic spoken announcements and front-desk dialogues to answer comprehension questions.

questions.prompt: Listen to the hotel receptionist. What time is complimentary breakfast served?

media.text: Good evening! Welcome to the Grand Oak Hotel. Complimentary buffet breakfast is served on the second floor every morning between six thirty and ten o'clock.

questions.explanation: The receptionist stated breakfast is served 'between six thirty and ten o'clock'.

questions.prompt: Listen to the airport gate announcement. What has changed about Flight 402?

media.text: Attention all passengers on Flight 402 to Chicago. Your departure gate has changed from Gate B4 to Gate C12. Boarding will commence in twenty minutes.

options.text: The departure gate was moved to C12.
The flight was canceled due to bad weather.
The plane has already landed in Chicago.

questions.explanation: The announcement explicitly states: 'Your departure gate has changed from Gate B4 to Gate C12'.

questions.prompt: Listen to the concierge. How much does the express airport shuttle cost?

media.text: Our express airport shuttle departs every forty minutes from the main entrance. Tickets are fifteen dollars per passenger, payable directly to the driver.

options.text: It is completely free for all guests

questions.explanation: The concierge specifies that tickets are 'fifteen dollars per passenger'.

questions.prompt: Listen to the front desk agent. What floor is the guest's room located on?

media.text: Here are your electronic keycards for Room 418 on the fourth floor. Take the elevators on your right side.

questions.explanation: The agent confirms: 'Room 418 on the fourth floor'.

questions.prompt: Listen to the train conductor. Which station is the next scheduled stop?

media.text: Next stop will be Central Station. Please make sure to collect all your personal belongings before leaving the train.

questions.explanation: The conductor announced: 'Next stop will be Central Station'.

questions.prompt: Listen to the hotel staff member. Where is the fitness center and indoor pool?

media.text: The fitness center and indoor heated pool are located in the basement level, open twenty-four hours a day with your room key.

options.text: Across the street in another building

questions.explanation: The staff member clearly states they are 'located in the basement level'.

questions.prompt: Listen to the gate agent. What is the baggage allowance for standard carry-on bags?

media.text: Each passenger in economy class is permitted one personal item and one carry-on bag weighing up to ten kilograms.

questions.explanation: The agent announces carry-on bags 'weighing up to ten kilograms'.

questions.prompt: Listen to the tour guide. When will the city sightseeing bus return to the hotel?

media.text: Our guided historical tour departs at nine in the morning and will return everyone safely to the hotel by five thirty in the evening.

questions.explanation: The guide states the tour 'will return everyone safely to the hotel by five thirty in the evening'.
